snippet.title: The Seance At Blake Manor Release Date Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences. This trailer reveals the release date, and was featured in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

Download the demo and wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395520/The_Sance_of_Blake_Manor/
